title: Bootstrap opencode-wui + Internal Types + Transformers + Tests
description:
## Scope (~130k tokens, 1 agent session)

### 1. Project Bootstrap
- Copy humanlayer-wui/ → opencode-wui/
- Remove @humanlayer/hld-sdk from package.json
- Add @opencode-ai/sdk to package.json
- Remove src/lib/daemon/ directory entirely
- Update package.json name/description
- bun install

### 2. Internal Types (src/lib/opencode/types.ts, ~150 lines)
- Define InternalSession — maps from opencode Session + SessionStatus
- Define InternalMessage (ConversationEvent equivalent) — flattened from Message + Part[]
- Define InternalPermission (Approval equivalent) — from PermissionRequest
- Define InternalEvent — normalized events from 43 opencode types
- Define SessionFilter, SessionCounts — client-side filtering types
- Export type aliases for backward compatibility where possible

### 3. Transformers (src/lib/opencode/transformers.ts, ~300 lines)
- transformSession(opencodeSession, statusMap?) → InternalSession
- transformMessages(messages: Message[]) → InternalMessage[]
  - Flatten Message → Part[] hierarchy into sequential events
  - Handle all 12 Part types (TextPart, ToolPart, ReasoningPart, etc.)
  - Map ToolPart states (pending/running/completed/error)
  - Preserve ordering by message.time.created + part sequence
- transformPermission(request: PermissionRequest) → InternalPermission
- aggregateSessionMetrics(messages: Message[]) → { cost, tokens }
- transformSessionStatus(status: SessionStatus) → InternalSessionStatus

### 4. Transformer Tests (src/lib/opencode/__tests__/transformers.test.ts, ~300 lines)
- transformMessages with text, tool calls, thinking, tool results
- transformSession with various statuses
- transformPermission
- aggregateSessionMetrics

### Key References
- Read: OPENCODE_MIGRATION_ROADMAP.md (Session 1 section)
- Read: opencode-ui-docs/research/R1_SDK_TYPE_REFERENCE.md (all Part types)
- Read: opencode-ui-docs/research/R3_PERMISSION_FLOW.md (permission types)

### Verification
```bash
bun test src/lib/opencode/
bun run typecheck  # may have errors in hooks/store — OK at this stage
```

title: Tauri server.rs + lib.rs + tauri.conf.json + frontend connection
description:
## Scope (~120k tokens, 1 agent session)

INDEPENDENT of Epic 1 (Adapter Layer) — can be done in parallel.

### 1. Server Process Manager (src-tauri/src/server.rs)
- Rename DaemonInfo → ServerInfo { port, pid, base_url, is_running }
- Find opencode binary (PATH or bundled)
- Launch: opencode serve --port 0 --hostname 127.0.0.1
- Parse port from stdout: loop lines until "opencode server listening on http://..."
  - Regex: /on\s+(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/
  - Handle warning line before listening line (R5)
- Pass config via OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT env var (R5: JSON string)
- Health check: GET /global/health → { "healthy": true, "version": "..." }
- Process monitoring (background task, 1s interval)
- Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM → wait 15s → SIGKILL (R5: no SIGTERM handler yet)

### 2. Tauri Commands (src-tauri/src/lib.rs)
- Rename commands: start_daemon → start_server, etc.
- Update env vars: HUMANLAYER_* → OPENCODE_*
- Update state management for ServerInfo
- Remove hld-specific logic (branch-based DB path, socket path)

### 3. Tauri Config (src-tauri/tauri.conf.json)
- Update productName, identifier, resources
- Remove bin/hld and bin/humanlayer from bundled resources
- Add bin/opencode if bundling (or rely on PATH)

### 4. Frontend Connection
- Update URL resolution (remove hld-specific URL detection)
- Use Tauri command get_server_info → http://localhost:{port}
- Fallback: http://localhost:4096
- Update health check to use /global/health
- Add x-opencode-directory header to all API calls (R5)

### Key References
- Read: R5_OPENCODE_SERVE_BEHAVIOR.md (CRITICAL — port detection, env vars, health)
- Read: OPENCODE_MIGRATION_ROADMAP.md (Session 2 section)
- Read: src-tauri/src/daemon.rs, src-tauri/src/lib.rs (existing code)

### Verification
```bash
cd src-tauri && cargo check  # Rust compiles
# Manual: launch app, check opencode starts and health check passes
```

title: Event Adapter + Client Wrapper + Index
description:
## Scope (~130k tokens, 1 agent session)

Depends on: Task 1.1 (types.ts and transformers.ts must exist)

### 1. Event Adapter (src/lib/opencode/events.ts, ~150 lines)
- createEventAdapter(opencodeStream) → InternalEventEmitter
- Map key SSE events:
  - session.status → session_status_changed
  - session.updated → session_settings_changed
  - session.created / session.deleted → session list refresh
  - permission.updated → new_permission (NOT permission.asked)
  - permission.replied → permission_resolved (SPIKE: event EXISTS)
  - message.updated + message.part.updated → conversation_updated
- Ignore non-essential events (lsp.updated, vcs.branch.updated, etc.)
- Heartbeat handling (server.heartbeat)

### 2. Client (src/lib/opencode/client.ts, ~400 lines)
- createOpencodeAdapter(config) → OpencodeAdapter
- Session methods:
  - listSessions() — client.session.list() + transform
  - getSession(id) — client.session.get() + status + transform
  - createSession(params) — client.session.create() + client.session.prompt()
  - continueSession(id, message) — client.session.prompt()
  - abortSession(id) — client.session.abort()
  - deleteSession(id) — client.session.delete()
  - forkSession(id, messageId?) — client.session.fork()
  - shareSession(id) / unshareSession(id)
  - getSessionDiff(id) — client.session.diff()
  - revertSession(id, messageId) / unrevertSession(id)
- Conversation methods:
  - getMessages(sessionId) — client.session.messages() + transform
- Permission methods:
  - respondToPermission(sessionId, permissionId, reply)
  - Active permissions tracked from SSE permission.updated events
  - Completion detected via permission.replied event
- File methods: findFiles, findText, readFile
- System methods: health, getConfig, listProviders, listAgents
- Event subscription: subscribe() → client.event.subscribe()

### 3. Index (src/lib/opencode/index.ts, ~20 lines)
- Barrel export all public API

### Key References
- Read: OPENCODE_MIGRATION_ROADMAP.md (Session 1, sections 1.4-1.5)
- Read: R1_SDK_TYPE_REFERENCE.md (SSE event types)
- Read: R3_PERMISSION_FLOW.md (permission respond API)
- Read: R5_OPENCODE_SERVE_BEHAVIOR.md (x-opencode-directory header)

### Verification
```bash
bun run typecheck  # adapter layer should compile clean
bun test src/lib/opencode/
```
